item.title: Kotlin Android Engineer (Japan Dev Platform)
item.description: 日本Dev平台上列出了13个需要Kotlin技能的职位，其中包括Android工程师岗位。这些职位提供签证担保，支持从海外申请，适合有Android开发和Kotlin经验的候选人。
item.content:encoded:
日本Dev平台上列出了13个需要Kotlin技能的职位，其中包括Android工程师岗位。这些职位提供签证担保，支持从海外申请，适合有Android开发和Kotlin经验的候选人。

  • Android开发职位，需要Kotlin技能
  • 优先考虑有Jetpack Compose经验的候选人
  • 提供签证担保，可从海外申请

来源 / Sources

  • Japan Dev: Jobs in Japan with Visa Sponsorship

item.title: Senior Software Engineer - Engage Studio at Treasure AI
item.description: Treasure AI is looking for a Senior Software Engineer for their Engage Studio in Tokyo. While primarily a full-stack role, mobile development experience is listed as a nice-to-have qualification.
item.content:encoded:
Treasure AI is looking for a Senior Software Engineer for their Engage Studio in Tokyo. While primarily a full-stack role, mobile development experience is listed as a nice-to-have qualification.

  • Full-stack role with Java, Go, Kotlin, Ruby, JavaScript stack
  • Mobile or SDK development experience is a plus
  • Partial remote work available
  • Japanese not required, business-level English needed
  • Residents of Japan only, no visa sponsorship

来源 / Sources

  • Senior Software Engineer - Engage Studio at Treasure AI

item.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer at Visual Alpha
item.description: Visual Alpha is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer for their financial AI platform in Tokyo. This role offers visa sponsorship and supports relocation to Japan with partial remote work.
item.content:encoded:
Visual Alpha is seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer for their financial AI platform in Tokyo. This role offers visa sponsorship and supports relocation to Japan with partial remote work.

  • Full-stack development role in Tokyo
  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support available
  • Partial remote work arrangement
  • Business-level Japanese and fluent English required
  • Salary range: 5M ~ 9M JPY annually
